status: DRAFT for review: short definitions of NAM terms that case.ask answers from; NRL may replace them with its Procurement Manual's wording

terms.pqc: Pre-Qualification Criteria: the experience, turnover and capability a bidder must show to have its bid considered.
terms.scc: Special Conditions of Contract: the terms specific to this contract (delivery, warranty, penalties) that add to or override the general conditions.
terms.gcc: General Conditions of Contract: NRL's standard terms that apply to every contract unless the SCC says otherwise.
terms.boq: Bill of Quantities: the itemised list of what is bought, each line with its quantity, unit and rate.
terms.sor: Schedule of Rates: an approved list of unit rates for standard works items; NRL SOR is NRL's own.
terms.dsr: Delhi Schedule of Rates (CPWD): a reference schedule for works rates, not NRL-approved, used with an alert when NRL SOR has no item.
terms.dar: Delhi Analysis of Rates (CPWD): the component analysis behind DSR rates.
terms.nit: Notice Inviting Tender: the tender document prepared after NAM, by the NIT module, from NAM's handoff package.
terms.pr: Purchase Requisition: the request to buy, raised in SAP (or Procurix.ai) with the items, quantities and estimated value.
terms.po: Purchase Order: the order placed with the selected vendor after the tender.
terms.emd: Earnest Money Deposit (bid security): the deposit a bidder pays with the bid; MSEs registered for the item are exempt.
terms.mse: Micro and Small Enterprise: gets purchase preference and EMD exemption under the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012.
terms.doa: Delegation of Authority: who may approve a procurement of what value.
terms.aan: Administrative Approval Note: the note that seeks approval for the procurement and its estimate.
terms.ann: Administrative Approval Note: the note that seeks approval for the procurement and its estimate.
terms.sap: SAP MM: NRL's ERP, where PRs and POs are recorded (not connected to NAM yet).
terms.aarohan: Aarohan: NRL's e-office system for files, approvals and document upload (not connected to NAM yet).
terms.gem: Government e-Marketplace: the government's online procurement platform.
terms.oem: Original Equipment Manufacturer: the maker of the item; a bidder that is not the OEM may need its authorisation.
terms.rate contract: An agreement fixing rates for an item over a period, ordered against as needed.
terms.new item: An estimate line with no rate from any source: the officer gives its rate before the estimate is approved.
terms.precedent: A past NRL tender the officer selected to build this case from; NAM never selects one itself (R2).
terms.varn: The variation between a quoted rate and the last awarded rate, in percent (R10).
terms.cagr: The yearly growth rate between the awarded rate and the quoted rate over the years between them (R10).
